proposal.name: Keep watcher leases through GitHub failures

plan.name: Keep watcher leases through GitHub failures
plan.summary: Keep a watcher's last confirmed lease after a failed read or a push error other than ErrLeaseMoved, allowing its steps and agent results to continue only until that lease's until minus the existing one-minute skew, while reporting errors and retrying renewal on each poll once due. A ref-moved refusal or a read of another holder's unexpired lease still stops it immediately, and successful renewal from the same commit or adoption of its own lost-answer push preserves the tenure and the existing late-push recovery rules (D-0072, D-0237, D-0245). Change watch's default lease from five to fifteen minutes while retaining half-life renewal, all existing -lease overrides and validation, and immediate release after drain or shutdown. Update SPEC.md's lease bullet and docs/factory.md to describe error retention, the fifteen-minute default and roughly sixteen-minute crash takeover delay, citing the existing decisions and issue #544's ratified plan. The merger must record the decision refining D-0072 for the new default and failure handling, which is not yet in the journal; this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestLeasePushFailuresKeepOnlyTheConfirmedWindow544
tests.says: Repeated 5xx, timeout and dropped-connection renewal errors keep effects authorized until exactly the last confirmed expiry minus one minute, retry against the same commit every due poll, and never create an unconfirmed lease.

tests.name: TestLeaseReadFailuresKeepOnlyTheConfirmedWindow544
tests.says: Failed lease reads preserve an existing holder's authority only within its confirmed window, never attempt a push without a read, and never authorize a watcher that has not acquired a lease.

tests.name: TestLeaseRecoveryKeepsTheRunningStep544
tests.says: A renewal that failed before landing can later succeed from the same commit without invalidating its running step, and a renewal whose answer was lost can be adopted after a failed read without inventing a tenure or an earlier extension.

tests.name: TestLeaseDefiniteLossOverridesErrorRetention544
tests.says: After tolerating a temporary renewal error, a wrapped ErrLeaseMoved or a read of another holder's unexpired lease immediately refuses effects; later read errors cannot restore that authority.

tests.name: TestBuildFinishesDuringLeaseRenewalOutage544
tests.says: A build finishing while renewal pushes still fail records and publishes its result within the confirmed lease instead of being discarded as stopped.

tests.name: TestWatchDefaultsToFifteenMinuteLease544
tests.says: Watch advertises and validates a fifteen-minute default lease, still accepts explicit allowed durations and zero, and still refuses leases of at most two minutes or shorter than three polls.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and acceptance tests, correcting the four comment counts and preserving the rest of the prior plan. Check 1 passed: all six tests fail on the unchanged base code, as required.
